parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs national document/entry exposure with a worst-ranked state facility/document regime and no working remedy in-state. Entry officers must refuse on sex discrepancy and may pursue lifetime fraud ineligibility; foreign X/mismatched passports are not accepted for new issuance and screening is documented with confiscations/detentions and allied advisories. National government facilities and this state's 2023 law restrict facilities by assigned sex, and birth-certificate changes are effectively closed except after genital surgery, forcing outing on document presentation. Custody evidence includes hormone removal/conversion practices and immigration-custody forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. National hate-crime and employment rulings and pending court challenges are partial protections, but state hate-crime law excludes gender identity, no state anti-discrimination protection applies, and no documented police sweeps or extortion campaign place this below 0.25 anchors or at 0.15 severity.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport sex must match assigned sex; X stopped Feb 2025, Supreme Court allowed Nov 2025. Entry cable requires refusal on document discrepancy/doubt and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Confiscations, detentions and foreign advisories documented.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, not automatic, limited waivers; civil-liberties suit pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry interacts with facilities/custody: refusal, stranded travel, potential lifetime ineligibility and detention.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 mandates hair cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men. Bathroom trespass arrest elsewhere in national framework shows handcuffing and men's-ward holding.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Earlier prison LGBTQ order rescinded; tattoo of litigation/challenges to some orders is not documented as remedy for custody practices. Not documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud allegation or facilities trespass can lead to detention where birth-sex placement and reported abuse increase severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. This state April 2023 law allows restriction in many state-run facilities; nationally 9 states ban in all government buildings, 4 make use criminal in certain circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus capital have no mapped ban, but this state does; private inclusive options do not override government rule. Not documented as remedy in this state.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Passport/ID mismatch makes facility use a forced-outing and potential trespass exposure in government buildings, schools and colleges.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care for minors illegal in this state from 2023; national orders target minor care, and hormone removal in custody is documented. Emergency ward practice for trans visitors not documented.
care_services.protection: National funding/insurance proposals and some orders are blocked/enjoined in part; adult emergency care access not documented as restricted. Not documented.
care_services.interaction: A travelling trans minor or adult needing medication faces state minor-care ban, school disclosure, and custody hormone denial if detained.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National executive order defines sex as binary at birth, removes gender-ideology materials, counterterrorism documents label 'radically pro-transgender' groups; state platform accused trans people of preying on women. Minor care and pronoun measures include criminal/penalty provisions.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Governor opposed anti-LGBTQ platform as divisive; 78% poll support anti-discrimination law; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity since 2009.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat framing supports enforcement of document, facility and school rules and may embolden private hostility, though no evidence of visitor sweeps.

minors_guardians.exposure: State bans assigned-male-at-birth students from female sports in schools/higher education, requires parental disclosure of trans students, forbids requiring/prohibiting pronoun use; national order directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: Several national orders blocked/enjoined, but scope for visiting minor not documented; conversion-therapy ban for some professionals documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent travelling with trans minor faces disclosure, sports exclusion, care ban and school pronoun rules if enrolled/service sought.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No dated incident of violence against trans person in this state documented; no visitor-specific assault rate. State hate-crime law excludes gender identity, 37 states lacked such statutes as of 2019 nationally.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime prosecution available; national crime statistics track sexual-orientation bias but gender-identity state coverage incomplete.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence of state hate-crime coverage weakens local recourse, but dossier does not document routine police targeting or refusal pattern in this state.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No state anti-discrimination statute; birth-certificate rule relationship between 2023 statute and 2008 surgery regulation unresolved; enforcement of pronoun penalty, ward/custody placement for visitors, and final disposition of religious-refusal bill not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National employment ruling 2020, city municipal/rental protections in one city, pending passport and executive-order litigation; some orders enjoined.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Courts are functioning but have upheld passport restriction; litigation does not restore facility access or entry acceptance in this state.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: universal birth-sex facility rule with document checks and courts rejecting relief. This case is similar or slightly lower because entry adds refusal/lifetime-fraud risk and custody hormone removal, beyond facilities alone.

Lower than 0.45-A: that anchor has a bathroom rule but ordinary emergency care, no organised arrests and one prosecuted assault. Here entry fraud exposure, closed birth-certificate changes, minor-care/pronoun bans and documented custody abuse add cumulative universal exposures.

Higher than 0.25-A: that anchor has repeated police raids, detention and extortion. This dossier documents no visitor raids, extortion or organised sweeps, and national courts/hate-crime law provide partial recourse, so severity/frequency are lower.

Materially lower than 0.55-A: that anchor has recurring service refusals with some corrections and a prosecuted assault, no facility ban. Here facility/entry restrictions are binding and unremedied in-state, not merely inconsistent service.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is the core risk: a mismatched or X passport triggers entry refusal or fraud scrutiny; the same mismatch forces outing for state ID/birth-certificate purposes and bars identity-congruent government facilities, with trespass exposure in some states; detention then exposes the traveller to documented hormone denial and abuse. For a minor, state care, sports, disclosure and pronoun rules compound the adult's exposure. National litigation, hate-crime law and local poll support are real but do not displace the operative entry, facility and state rules. No documented execution, organised sweeps or police extortion keeps this above 0.25, while multiple unremedied tier-1 exposures keep it at 0.35 level.
